subject: general
question: What is the primary purpose of implementing Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures when working on a DC motor?

options.text: To prevent accidental startup during maintenance

solution:
__**Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)**__

Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) is a safety procedure used to ensure that machines and equipment are properly shut off and cannot be started unexpectedly while maintenance, servicing, or repair work is being performed.

**Purpose of LOTO:**

The primary purpose of implementing Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures is to prevent accidental startup of the DC motor during maintenance.

When working on a DC motor:

 
• Electrical and mechanical energy can cause serious injury if the motor starts unexpectedly.
 
• LOTO ensures the motor is completely isolated from its power source.
 
• It prevents accidental or unauthorized energization while maintenance or servicing is being carried out.
